She understands facial structure so well and creates makeup looks that truly suit you. Even during the trial sessions, she gives her 100% and pays attention to every detail. She is punctual, warm, and incredibly comforting—exactly what every bride needs.

My face had acne and marks, but not once did she suggest unnecessary pre-bridal treatments. Instead, she worked with so much care and skill that she boosted my confidence and made me feel beautiful in my own skin. She is genuinely dedicated and very serious about her craft.

On my wedding day, my rituals began early—around 8 AM—and there she was at 4 AM, arriving with a cheerful, friendly smile. She brings the kind of positive energy every bride needs to start her big day. Her makeup is top-notch, but what truly sets her apart is her vibe and aura—those cannot be copied. She makes you feel like your best friend is doing your makeup.

To anyone reading this: just close your eyes and trust her. She is an amazing makeup artist, and I still feel short of words to express how grateful I am for her work.

featured_reviews.name: Sumi Sam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had such a wonderful experience with Mrunal! She was incredibly calm and composed throughout, which instantly put me at ease. Her work was amazing, she kept the look simple yet managed to beautifully enhance my natural features, exactly what I wanted. I had booked her for my Engagement and wedding

She even traveled all the way to my place in Kalyan and arrived before time, which I really appreciated. Despite a few hiccups due to power cuts, she handled everything so smoothly and made sure I stayed relaxed and stress-free.

She also kindly did a little playful “makeup” for my 2-year-old niece just to keep her happy, which was such a thoughtful and sweet gesture.

Truly professional, talented, and such a soothing presence to have on an important day. Highly recommend her!

featured_reviews.name: Suzanne Michel
featured_reviews.review_text:
I honestly can’t thank Mrunal enough for being such a big and beautiful part of my wedding day! From the very first time I walked into her studio, she felt like home. Calm, easy-going, down-to-earth, and yet so strong—our first meeting itself had me convinced that she was the one. Decision made that very day ✔️

Fast forward to the wedding day—she walked in nice and early, fully prepped, totally in control. All I had to do was sit back, relax, and enjoy the glow-up moment 👑✨

Beyond her insane talent, she’s such a kind, supportive human being, both personally and professionally. If you want to look amazing, feel confident, and actually enjoy the whole makeup process—from trial to the big day—close your eyes and choose Mrunal. Forever grateful and forever recommending her 🫂✨💋

featured_reviews.name: Crizanne Michel

From choosing you as my MUA till the big day, you have been an amazing person throughout.

I’m so grateful to have had you by my side—guiding me, calming me down, and making me feel confident and comfortable at the same time.
Highly recommended 🤍
